astranl.do_not_use_when: you need a binding quote, a reservation or an order; or the part is a machine or robot component with a manufacturer part number (use ground_component)
astranl.example_intent: Is Alabastine Muurvuller 8710839100056 cheaper elsewhere right now?
astranl.next_possible_action: estimate_case_create to price a whole job; check_estimate_materials to watch its materials
astranl.use_when: you need the current price and stock of a specific building material, or want to know whether the identical trade item is cheaper at another Dutch store, with proof of where and when it was read

annotations.title: Check a building material in live store reality

description: Check one building material in live Dutch store reality with ONE read-only call. Exact identity only: a GTIN with valid check digit, a store variant or the exact partner feed link; plain words return candidates you can check exactly next. Returns every offer of the same trade item with price incl. VAT, stock and read time per store (Bouwmaat, Hubo, Houtdirect through UCP search; partner shop feeds), the identical GTIN at other stores (verdict DIRECT_SUBSTITUTE, the only substitute named), the cheapest available offer, per source status and a sha256 digest. Limits: seller prices at read time, not a quote or delivery promise; delivery costs not included; NOT_FOUND covers only the sources listed. Never orders, pays or contacts anyone. A postcode adds delivery cost and dates per offer. Exact grade, material, size and pack are matched and near misses are listed separately.

detail.description: short (default): at most three offers to show the person; full: every offer, delivery rule and source.

need_date.description: ISO planning date (YYYY-MM-DD), passed as the order date for delivery quotes; defaults to today in Europe/Amsterdam.

postcode.description: Dutch delivery postcode: 1234AB, 1234 AB or 1234. Adds per-offer delivery quotes.

quantity.description: Number of store units as sold, from 1 to 10000. Packs are not converted.

ref.description: a GTIN or EAN with valid check digit (e.g. 8710839100056), a Bouwmaat, Hubo or Houtdirect product link with ?variant=, a partner shop product link, store:variant (e.g. hubo:48564194312444), or plain words for candidates

name: check_material
